privacy_policy_intro: This Privacy Policy explains how KISELOV ANDRII ("we", "our", or "Developer") processes data when you use the Beauty Planner mobile application.
privacy_policy_section_1_p1: Beauty Planner stores and processes data you enter while using the app, including client name, client phone number, appointment date and time, service name, price, comments, payment status, custom services, schedule settings, and other related data.
privacy_policy_section_1_p2: For account and authentication features, the app may process user identifiers (for example Firebase UID), email address, display name, and sign-in provider (for example Google, Apple, email/password, or anonymous mode).
privacy_policy_section_1_p3: For subscription and access-management features, the app may process technical data related to purchases and access status.
privacy_policy_section_2_p1: Appointment data and part of app settings are stored locally on your device.
privacy_policy_section_2_p2: If you use account, cloud sync, subscription, or access recovery features, part of the data may be processed and stored in cloud infrastructure, including Firebase Authentication, Cloud Firestore, and Cloud Functions.
privacy_policy_section_2_p3: Backups are created only by your action (export). You choose where to store them. If encryption is enabled, the backup is protected by a password that you set.
privacy_policy_section_3_p1: The app supports sign-in with Google, Sign in with Apple, email/password, and guest (anonymous) mode.
privacy_policy_section_3_p2: When signing in with an account, the app may process email address, profile name, sign-in provider, and a technical user identifier for authentication, synchronization, and access linking.
privacy_policy_section_3_p3: Guest mode allows local use of the app without full cloud account linkage.
privacy_policy_section_4_p1: On Android, the app uses Google Play Billing, and on iOS it uses App Store / StoreKit mechanisms for Premium subscription purchase and restore.
privacy_policy_section_4_p2: Bank card payment data is processed by the relevant store platform (Google Play or Apple App Store). The app does not directly receive your card details.
privacy_policy_section_4_p3: To activate, restore, and maintain Premium, the app may process technical purchase data such as productId, purchaseToken, transactionId, subscription state, expiry time, auto-renew status, and related order identifiers where available.
privacy_policy_section_4_p4: To verify and update subscription status, the app may use server-side verification through backend services and cloud functions.
privacy_policy_section_5_p1: If you use an authenticated account and the corresponding access level, the app may synchronize appointments and related settings between devices.
privacy_policy_section_5_p2: For this purpose, the app may process appointments, app settings, technical update markers, and account identifiers needed to merge local and cloud data.
privacy_policy_section_6_p1: For certain features, the app may request device permissions.
privacy_policy_section_6_b2: Contacts — to suggest client names and phone numbers when creating appointments. On Android and iOS, contact access is used only after user permission is granted.
privacy_policy_section_6_b3: File access — only through the system file picker for backup import/export.
privacy_policy_section_6_b4: Run after reboot (on Android) — to restore scheduled reminders.
privacy_policy_section_7_p1: The app may query backend configuration to determine whether a newer app version is available and to obtain the relevant app store link.
privacy_policy_section_7_p2: For this purpose, the app may use information about the platform, current app version, and build number.
privacy_policy_section_8_p1: If you enable encrypted backups, the backup is protected by a password that you choose.
privacy_policy_section_8_p2: We cannot recover that password if it is lost. You are responsible for keeping your backup password safe.
privacy_policy_section_9_p1: We do not sell your personal data.
privacy_policy_section_9_p2: Data may be shared only with technology providers required to deliver app functionality, including authentication services, cloud infrastructure, notifications, and app store platforms, within the scope described in this Policy.
privacy_policy_section_9_p3: Such providers may include Apple, Google, Firebase, and related services used by the app.
privacy_policy_section_10_p1: You can delete local data by clearing app storage on your device and/or deleting backup files you created.
privacy_policy_section_10_p2: If you use an account, related server-side data (for example access profile, subscription status, and cloud appointments/settings) may be stored in app infrastructure until deletion or for a technically justified retention period.
privacy_policy_section_10_p3: If you want to request deletion of related data or ask questions about your data, you can contact us at the address below.
privacy_policy_section_11_p1: We apply reasonable technical and organizational safeguards to protect data within the platforms and infrastructure used.
privacy_policy_section_11_p2: You are responsible for the security of your device, account, email credentials, and backup password (if backup encryption is enabled).
privacy_policy_section_12_p1: We may update this Privacy Policy. The current version is published in the app with the latest update date.
privacy_policy_section_13_p1: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, data processing, or data deletion requests, you can contact us at:

guide_common_main_sections_of_settings: Main sections of the Settings screen:
guide_app_overview_p1: Beauty Planner is a scheduling and business management app designed for beauty professionals, including independent specialists, home-based service providers, and salon workers.
guide_app_overview_p2: The app helps users manage appointments, clients, services, reminders, backups, and profile settings in one place. It is designed to replace paper notes, scattered reminders, and fragmented scheduling workflows with a single structured workspace.
guide_app_overview_p3: The app is intended for adult users who independently manage their own appointments and work schedule.
guide_app_overview_feature_1: Quick appointment creation through a calendar-based workflow
guide_app_overview_feature_2: Client name and phone autofill based on previous appointments
guide_app_overview_feature_8: Unavailable time and work schedule management
guide_access_model_p1: The app includes two access levels.
guide_access_model_free_p1: The free version provides the essential daily workflow for appointment management.
guide_access_model_free_p2: The user can keep up to 5 active visible appointments at the same time.
guide_access_model_free_p3: Completed and historical appointments remain available for later viewing and record keeping.
guide_access_model_premium_p1: The Premium subscription removes the active appointment limit and unlocks additional professional tools, including:
guide_access_model_premium_feature_5: additional tools for business and client workflow management
guide_first_launch_sign_in_p1: When the app is launched for the first time, the user is taken to the authentication screen.
guide_first_launch_sign_in_p2: After a successful sign in, the main calendar screen opens.
guide_first_launch_sign_in_p3: Guest mode is also available in the current build and allows the user to use the app without creating a full account-based workflow.
guide_main_screen_p1: The main screen is the primary workspace of the app. It consists of two key sections:
guide_main_screen_calendar_body: The upper part of the screen displays a calendar for date selection, daily navigation, and appointment planning.
guide_main_screen_upcoming_body: The lower part of the screen displays upcoming client appointments automatically sorted by date and time.
guide_main_screen_p2: This screen serves as the main daily workspace for the professional.
guide_settings_screen_p1: The Settings screen opens by tapping the gear icon in the upper-right corner of the main screen.
guide_settings_screen_p2: This section contains the main app settings and workflow management tools. From here, the user can access personal data, app appearance, services, schedule settings, notifications, backups, security settings, and subscription options.
guide_common_on_this_screen_the_user_can: On this screen, the user can:
guide_common_in_this_section_the_user_ca: In this section, the user can:
guide_professional_profile_p1: The Professional Profile section is used to configure personal information and profile display settings.
guide_professional_profile_p2: The user can view and update profile information and choose how it is displayed inside the app.
guide_professional_profile_p3: At the bottom of this screen, the Delete Account function is available for permanent account deletion.
guide_professional_profile_item_5: show the professional name instead of the system account name
guide_appearance_theme_p1: The Appearance and Theme section allows the user to customize the visual presentation of the app and its display preferences.
guide_appearance_theme_p2: The app supports multiple interface languages and multiple currencies for use in different regions and business scenarios.
guide_appearance_theme_p3: After changing these settings, the user saves them and the changes are applied immediately within the app.
guide_subscription_access_p1: The Subscription and Access section is used to review the benefits of the paid version of the app, check the current subscription status, and proceed to the purchase flow.
guide_subscription_access_p2: This screen also contains links to the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.
guide_subscription_access_p3: The Premium subscription unlocks advanced app features, including full statistics, archive access, expanded appointment management tools, and additional backup capabilities.
guide_subscription_access_item_2: review the benefits of the Premium subscription
guide_subscription_access_item_3: proceed to the subscription purchase flow
guide_my_services_p1: The My Services section works as a personal catalog of procedures and pricing.
guide_my_services_p2: Created services are then used during appointment creation. This allows the user to select a prepared service from a list instead of manually entering the service name and price every time.
guide_unavailable_time_schedule_p1: The Unavailable Time Schedule section is used to configure the times when the user is not available to accept clients.
guide_unavailable_time_schedule_p2: Configured intervals are used during appointment planning and help prevent accidental booking during unavailable hours.
guide_unavailable_time_schedule_p3: This tool is especially useful for users who combine beauty work with another schedule and want to block specific days or time periods in advance.
guide_notifications_p1: The Notifications section is used to configure reminders for upcoming appointments.
guide_notifications_p2: This section helps the user avoid missing scheduled appointments and supports a flexible reminder workflow.
guide_security_p1: The Security section is used to protect access to the app and restrict access to sensitive data.
guide_security_p2: After PIN protection is enabled, the app may request the PIN when opened, providing additional protection for locally stored data.
guide_security_p3: Functions related to backup and database clearing are additionally tied to the PIN-based protection flow.
guide_backup_p1: The Backup section is used for local data export and restoration.
guide_backup_p2: A backup can be used for transferring data to another device or for local data preservation.
guide_backup_p3: The database clearing function removes working appointment data without deleting the user account itself.
guide_backup_item_3: use a password to encrypt the exported file

guide_side_menu_p2: It is used for quick navigation between the main app sections and displays summary information about the current user.
guide_side_menu_p3: The upper part of the side menu shows:
guide_side_menu_item_4: actions for account switching or sign out
guide_statistics_p1: The Statistics section is used to analyze the user’s work results for a selected period.
guide_statistics_p2: This section works as an analytical tool for evaluating workload and financial performance.
guide_unpaid_appointments_p1: The Unpaid Appointments section is used to display appointments for which payment was postponed.
guide_unpaid_appointments_p2: These entries are created when the user marks an appointment as payable later during appointment creation.
guide_unpaid_appointments_p3: Once payment is confirmed, the appointment status is updated and it no longer appears as unpaid.
guide_unpaid_appointments_item_1: review the list of unpaid appointments
guide_unpaid_appointments_item_3: confirm payment after receiving money from the client
guide_archive_p1: The Archive section is used to review completed and past appointments.
guide_archive_p2: The archive works as a historical section for reviewing previously completed appointments and using them for later analysis.
guide_creating_new_appointment_p1: Appointment creation is performed through the main screen and the calendar-based workflow.
guide_creating_new_appointment_p2: After saving, the appointment immediately appears in the schedule and in the upcoming appointments list.
guide_creating_new_appointment_step_1: select the required date in the calendar grid
guide_creating_new_appointment_step_4: add the phone number if needed
guide_creating_new_appointment_step_5: select a service from the list or enter it manually
guide_creating_new_appointment_step_6: review the price and additional details
guide_creating_new_appointment_step_8: activate the Pay Later option if needed
guide_client_data_autofill_p1: When entering the client’s name, the app can suggest previously used entries based on existing appointment data.
guide_client_data_autofill_p2: If the user works with the same client again, the name and phone number can be selected more quickly through the built-in autofill mechanism.
guide_client_data_autofill_p3: On Android, device contacts may also be used to simplify suggestions if the user grants the required permission.
guide_client_data_autofill_p4: In the iOS review build, the primary suggestion flow is based on the app’s local data.
guide_editing_appointment_p1: The user can open an existing appointment and change its parameters.
guide_editing_appointment_p2: After saving, the changes are immediately applied to the schedule.
guide_rescheduling_appointment_p1: If the client asks to change the appointment date or time, the user can use the rescheduling function.
guide_rescheduling_appointment_p2: This workflow allows the user to quickly update the schedule without deleting and recreating the appointment.
guide_rescheduling_appointment_step_3: proceed to a new date selection
guide_deleting_appointment_p1: If an appointment is cancelled, the user can remove it from the schedule through the corresponding confirmation dialog.
guide_deleting_appointment_p2: After confirmation, the appointment is removed from the active scheduling workflow.
